Voice or text answers. Adaptive partners. Personal feedback.

Interviews and academic discussions require answers in context. Knowing vocabulary alone does not prepare a learner for every situation.
CYPHER gives learners a simulated partner, opportunities to retry and feedback on their answers.

Guidance when an answer is difficult
2. The user can retry, up to three attempts per question.
3. An explicit “I don’t know” skips the question.
4. The session moves on after the answer or the final attempt.

The partner reacts to the answer
Clear, relevant and developed answers can reduce pressure.
Unclear, brief or uncertain responses can increase pressure.
The interface reflects the partner’s mood.
Reaching maximum pressure ends the conversation and contributes to the results.
